stories.title: SEBI board approves PMS overhaul and settlement-rules revamp
stories.body: in September 2026 the SEBI board approved a comprehensive revamp of the Portfolio Managers Regulations: PMS providers may now invest client funds in direct mutual-fund schemes and Specialised Investment Funds (SIFs) through PRIM, with a ₹25 lakh minimum ticket size, and up to 10% of client AUM in investment-grade unlisted debt under discretionary PMS with client consent, plus access to IPOs, primary debt issuances and exchange-traded derivatives. It also overhauled the settlement framework — a formula-based method for settlement amounts, wider access to settlement proceedings, a fast-track mechanism for disclosure-related violations up to ₹10 lakh, the application window extended from 60 to 90 days, and a separate 90-day one-time settlement window for specified pending cases. Other approvals: FPIs get access to exchange-traded commodity derivatives, Vault Manager rules expanded to bullion-linked ETFs with minimum net worth raised to ₹75 crore, eased retrospective listing norms for unlisted NCDs, and a 4th settlement scheme for illiquid stock-option cases.

stories.title: Net FDI hits five-year high of $7.35 billion in July 2026
stories.body: RBI data released in September 2026 (monthly bulletin) shows net Foreign Direct Investment rose to USD 7.35 billion in July 2026, the highest since May 2021's $8.80 billion and up 64% YoY. Gross inflows stood at $14.58 billion (third-highest in six years); communication, financial and computer services drew over 60% of equity inflows. For April–July 2026, net FDI reached $13.4 billion vs $9.7 billion a year earlier (+38%); gross inflows grew 12.6% from $38.9B to $43.9B.

stories.title: IndusInd Bank launches 'GCC Banking Vertical'
stories.body: India's private-sector lender launched a dedicated Global Capability Centre (GCC) banking vertical integrating five core capabilities under one relationship: digital banking, employee banking, commercial card solutions, capital-account & FEMA solutions, and foreign-currency accounts via its International Banking Unit at GIFT City, Gandhinagar. Context: India's GCC ecosystem has grown 32% since FY21 to 2,117 GCCs. IndusInd Bank, established 1994, is headquartered in Mumbai.

stories.title: Livestock Insurance Portal (Pashudhan Bima Portal) launched
stories.body: Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh (Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying; Panchayati Raj) launched the Livestock Insurance Portal in New Delhi, a unified digital platform under the National Livestock Mission's livestock-insurance activity for farmers, insurers and implementing agencies. Exam facts: available in 11 regional languages plus Hindi and English; features digital application submission, real-time monitoring, faster claim processing and data-driven reporting.

stories.title: Steel Industry Safety Council (SISC) announced
stories.body: the Ministry of Steel announced an apex-level body to strengthen safety standards, practices and accident prevention across India's steel sector. SISC will be chaired by Sandeep Poundrik, Secretary, Ministry of Steel, with CEOs of steel companies and representatives from DGMS, PESO, NDMA and technical institutions; the Steel Industry Safety Directorate (SISD) will provide technical support, audits and incident investigations.

stories.title: Seva First Innovation Challenge inaugurated at IISc
stories.body: Union Education Minister Pralhad Joshi inaugurated the South-Zone Seva First Innovation Challenge (SFIC) at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, asking youth to solve community problems with innovative, testable, scalable solutions. Registration runs 25 September–24 October 2026; the national finale is in New Delhi in December 2026. Organised by MoE, AICTE and UGC with IISc as nodal institute; three levels (Junior: classes 6–12; Technical: ITI/polytechnic; Open: UG/PG/research scholars); covers five states (Karnataka, TN, Kerala, AP, Telangana) + three UTs (A&N Islands, Lakshadweep, Puducherry).

stories.title: Delhi's 'Udyog Mitra' single-window portal launched
stories.body: Chief Minister Rekha Gupta launched the 'Delhi Udyog Mitra' portal under the Ease of Doing Business initiative — a single-window platform for licences and NOCs, integrating 50+ services from 15 departments (to expand to 100+ services, 21 departments) with SSO, Common Application Form and 'Know Your Approvals', linked to the National Single Window System. Expected to benefit 8+ lakh traders and MSMEs.

stories.title: PRAHAAR: India's first national counter-terrorism policy
stories.body: Union Home Minister Amit Shah unveiled PRAHAAR (Policy for Response Against Hostile Activities and Radicalism) — India's first national counter-terrorism policy and strategy — at a New Delhi conference of central security agencies and state/UT police leadership (reported 29 Sept). Insights IAS flags it as a seven-pillar framework strengthening counter-terrorism coordination — a ready-made GS-3 internal-security anchor.

stories.title: India at 14th EAS-EMM and 23rd ASEAN-India Economic Ministers' meeting, Manila
stories.body: India participated in the 14th East Asia Summit Economic Ministers' Meeting and the 23rd ASEAN-India Economic Ministers' Consultation in Manila, Philippines (22–24 September 2026), led by Nitin Kumar Yadav, Additional Secretary, Department of Commerce. India pushed a balanced, trade-facilitative review of the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA); India–ASEAN trade hit USD 128.38 billion in 2025–26, accounting for 10.55% of India's global trade.

stories.title: HAL–SkyPulse MoU: ₹2,491 crore, 30-helicopter programme
stories.body: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd and SkyPulse Solutions IFSC Pvt Ltd signed an MoU for a strategic framework covering acquisition, financing, leasing, deployment and lifecycle support of HAL-built helicopters: 30 helicopters (single & twin-engine) in phases — 10 in 2027–2029, 20 from 2030, induction from FY27-28 — valued at ₹2,491 crore. Models: finance lease, operating lease, sale-and-leaseback; uses include HEMS (Helicopter Emergency Medical Services), disaster response, search & rescue, tourism, UDAN; boosts MRO, training and Make in India.

stories.title: TakeMe2Space to launch India's first orbital data centre on Falcon 9 in 2028
stories.body: the Hyderabad spacetech will launch two 100-kg My Orbital Infrastructure (MOI) constellation satellites to a ~500 km sun-synchronous orbit as part of the Waymaker 2 rideshare (managed by RIDE! Space / SEOPS), aiming at a 6-satellite constellation. Each satellite carries 10 NVIDIA Thor GPUs, 100 TB storage, 1.5 kW power with optical inter-satellite links — India's first mission designed for networked in-orbit computing.

stories.title: Tata Communications sets up cybersecurity CoE at SASTRA
stories.body: Tata Communications launched a Centre of Excellence in cybersecurity and digital forensics at SASTRA Deemed University, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu (₹3.5 crore investment), launched by MD & CEO Ganesh Lakshminarayanan. TCL (formerly VSNL), HQ Mumbai, incorporated 19 March 1986.

stories.title: Skytrax 2026: Singapore Airlines world's best; Air India jumps to 57th
stories.body: at the Langham Hotel, London, Skytrax (the "Oscars of the aviation industry", running since 1999) named Singapore Airlines the World's Best Airline for 2026; Qatar Airways 2nd (also best business class, 13th time), Cathay Pacific 3rd, ANA 4th, Turkish Airlines 5th. Air India ranked 57th — up 27 places from 2025, the highest-ranked Indian airline and top of the India & South Asia regional list; IndiGo 61st, second-highest Indian carrier and Best Low-Cost Airline in India & South Asia.

stories.title: Bodhana Sivanandan, 11, becomes youngest Woman Grandmaster
stories.body: Indian-origin British chess prodigy Bodhana Sivanandan became the youngest Woman Grandmaster in history at age 11, securing her third and final WGM norm representing England at the 46th Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Uzbekistan (8/11 on Board 1), surpassing Kateryna Lagno's 2002 record (12 years 4 months). She also earned her second IM norm; England finished 15th. India watch: V.S. Rathanvel of Coimbatore became India's 99th GM (crossed 2500 Elo at the Guwahati Smart City International Open, July 2026).

stories.title: WorldSkills Shanghai 2026: India 10th, 6 silver medals
stories.body: at the 48th WorldSkills Competition (22–27 September 2026, Shanghai, China), India finished 10th with 6 Silver Medals and 20 Medallions of Excellence, improving from 13th at Lyon 2024 — its largest-ever contingent (70 competitors, 63 skills, debut in 11 new categories). Silvers: Smriti Nambiar (Bakery — also Best of Nation), Mohammed Salam (Dental Prosthetics), Kovid Ajay Gangrade (Digital Interactive Media Design), Parth Vohra (Industrial Design Technology), Mehrunissa Begum (Logistics & Freight Forwarding), Saniya Joshi (Retail Sales). China topped the table; next edition WorldSkills Aichi 2028 (15–20 Nov 2028, Japan). WorldSkills (estd 1950, HQ Amsterdam) is biennial.

stories.title: 9th India International Water Week (22–26 Sept)
stories.body: the Ministry of Jal Shakti organised the 9th India International Water Week at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, with participants from 150 countries; inaugurated by Vice President C P Radhakrishnan. 2026 theme: "Climate Resilient Water Management". The forum was conceptualised in 2012 (first edition April 10–14, 2012); this edition featured the 2nd India International WASH Conference with an India-Africa roundtable for SDG 6.

stories.title: Indian peafowl recorded for the first time in Assam's Orang NP
stories.body: the Indian Peafowl (Pavo cristatus) was recorded for the first time in Orang National Park and Tiger Reserve, Assam on 28 September 2026 (GKToday).

stories.title: Gujarat restructures Porbandar Forest Division for lion rehabilitation
stories.body: Gujarat restructured the Porbandar Forest Division on 29 September 2026 to strengthen forest administration and support lion rehabilitation in the Barda region.

stories.title: First PRAMAAN certificates issued under IFWCS
stories.body: India issued its first PRAMAAN certificates under the Indian Forest and Wood Certification Scheme (IFWCS) on 29 September 2026, handed over to Andhra Pradesh (GKToday).

stories.title: Ladakh sends first 15,000-stem lilium consignment
stories.body: the first consignment of 15,000 A-grade Lilium stems from Ladakh was flagged off on 29 September 2026 for major Indian flower markets (GKToday).

stories.title: Guinness record: 116 autonomous underwater vehicles at once
stories.body: a Chinese team set a Guinness World Record on 29 August 2026 for the most autonomous underwater vehicles operating simultaneously — 116 AUVs, zero human intervention (GKToday).

stories.title: Amit Shah inaugurates Barapullah flyover + three road projects in Delhi
stories.body: the Union Home Minister inaugurated four road infrastructure projects in Delhi on 29 September 2026 at a combined cost of ₹1,941 crore, including the Barapullah flyover (GKToday).

stories.title: INS Ranvijay makes port call at Salalah, Oman
stories.body: the Indian Navy's frontline destroyer INS Ranvijay made a port call at Salalah, Oman on 29 September 2026 (GKToday).

stories.title: FICCI FRAMES 2026 in Mumbai
stories.body: the 26th edition of FICCI FRAMES, Asia's media-and-entertainment convention, is being held 29–30 September 2026 at the Grand Hyatt, Mumbai, Maharashtra (GKToday).

stories.title: ASCI issues AI-generated advertising labelling guidelines
stories.body: the Advertising Standards Council of India released the "Guidelines for Responsible Labelling of Synthetically Generated Content in Advertising" on 29 September 2026 (GKToday).

stories.title: India re-enters top 10 at 53 medals (6G/21S/26B); javelin silver–bronze, Gulveer makes history
stories.body: overnight results (Indian Express Day-12 live tracker, Sep 30 07:27 IST): India's tally stands at 53 medals = 6 gold, 21 silver, 26 bronze, 10th, after an 8-medal Day 11. Men's javelin: Yashvir Singh won silver with a personal best 85.72m, Rohit Yadav bronze with 84.35m; gold went to Sri Lanka's Rumesh Pathirage (88.55m). Neeraj Chopra — ruled out by injury before Japan, a two-time defending champion — hailed both in a 29 Sept X post (the field also featured Paris Olympic champion Arshad Nadeem). Gulveer Singh's 5000m bronze (13:32.75) makes him the first Indian man to win three individual medals at a single Asian Games; the women's 4×400m relay gold (3:29.69 — Kiran Pahal, Poovamma MR, Prachi, Vithya Ramraj; Bahrain silver 3:30.21, China bronze 3:31.02) was cheered by PM Modi. India's earlier firsts: Mirabai Chanu's weightlifting 49kg silver (first since Karnam Malleswari, 1998), soft tennis (Jay Meena) and MMA (Suchika Tariyal) debut medals, first rowing double-sculls medal (Satnam Singh/Salman Khan). Day 12 today (30 Sept): women's compound archery semifinal vs South Korea (Chikitha Taniparthi, Prithika Pradeep, Jyothi Surekha Vennam), women's hockey semifinal vs South Korea, boxers incl. Lovlina Borgohain to confirm medals, Anish Bhanwala in shooting qualification, and men's golf Round 1 (Saptak Talwar joint-top at 3 under).

one_liners: SEBI board: PMS overhaul — new PRIM route lets PMS invest in direct MF schemes + SIFs (₹25 lakh min ticket), up to 10% AUM in unlisted debt; settlement rules revamped — formula-based amounts, fast-track up to ₹10 lakh, application window 60 → 90 days + 90-day one-time window; FPIs get exchange-traded commodity derivatives; Vault Managers — min net worth ₹75 cr, bullion ETFs covered.
RBI bulletin: net FDI $7.35B in July 2026 — 5-yr high (since May 2021), +64% YoY; gross inflows $14.58B; communication/financial/computer services >60%; Apr–Jul net FDI $13.4B vs $9.7B last year.
IndusInd Bank: dedicated GCC Banking vertical — 5 capabilities (digital, employee, cards, capital-account/FEMA, forex) via GIFT City IBU; India now has 2,117 GCCs (32% growth since FY21).
Pashudhan Bima Portal: launched by Rajiv Ranjan Singh under the National Livestock Mission — digital livestock insurance in 11 regional languages + Hindi/English.
SISC: Ministry of Steel's new apex Steel Industry Safety Council, chaired by Steel Secretary Sandeep Poundrik; SISD does audits/investigations.
Seva First Innovation Challenge: inaugurated by Pralhad Joshi at IISc Bengaluru; registration 25 Sept–24 Oct 2026, finale New Delhi Dec 2026; MoE+AICTE+UGC; 3 levels, 5 states + 3 UTs.
Delhi Udyog Mitra: Rekha Gupta launches single-window licences/NOCs portal — 50+ services, 15 depts, 8L+ traders; linked to NSWS.

PRAHAAR: India's first national counter-terrorism policy & strategy — Policy for Response Against Hostile Activities and Radicalism — unveiled by Amit Shah at a New Delhi security conference (7 pillars).
EAS-EMM (14th) + ASEAN-India EM (23rd), Manila, 22–24 Sept: led by Nitin Kumar Yadav; AITIGA review push; India–ASEAN trade $128.38B in 2025–26 (10.55% of India's global trade).
HAL × SkyPulse: ₹2,491 cr MoU for 30 helicopters (10 in 2027–29, 20 from 2030); HEMS, UDAN, disaster response, leasing models.
TakeMe2Space: India's first orbital data centre — two 100-kg MOI sats, NVIDIA Thor GPUs, on Falcon 9 (late 2028); 500-km SSO; RIDE! Space agreement.
Tata Communications CoE in cybersecurity & digital forensics at SASTRA Thanjavur (₹3.5 cr).
Skytrax 2026: Singapore Airlines world's best; Qatar Airways 2nd; Air India 57th (+27, best Indian); IndiGo 61st (best low-cost India & South Asia).
Bodhana Sivanandan (11): youngest WGM in history — third norm at 46th Chess Olympiad, Samarkand (England, 8/11 Board 1); India's 99th GM = V.S. Rathanvel (July 2026).

WorldSkills Shanghai 2026: India 10th, 6 silver + 20 Medallions of Excellence (largest contingent: 70, 63 skills); silvers — Nambiar (Bakery, Best of Nation), Salam, Gangrade, Vohra, Begum, Joshi; next: Aichi 2028.
9th India International Water Week (22–26 Sept, Bharat Mandapam, 150 countries): inaugurated by VP C P Radhakrishnan; theme "Climate Resilient Water Management"; since 2012.
Orang NP (Assam): Indian peafowl (Pavo cristatus) recorded for the first time (28 Sept).
Porbandar: Gujarat restructures forest division for lion rehabilitation in Barda (29 Sept).
PRAMAAN: India's first PRAMAAN certificates under IFWCS handed to Andhra Pradesh (29 Sept).
Ladakh: first 15,000-stem lilium consignment flagged off (29 Sept).
Guinness: China sets record — 116 autonomous underwater vehicles operating simultaneously (29 Aug 2026).
INS Ranvijay: port call at Salalah, Oman (29 Sept).
Delhi infra: Amit Shah inaugurates 4 road projects, ₹1,941 cr, incl. Barapullah flyover (29 Sept).
FICCI FRAMES 2026: 26th edition, 29–30 Sept, Grand Hyatt Mumbai.
ASCI: guidelines for labelling AI-generated ads — "Guidelines for Responsible Labelling of Synthetically Generated Content in Advertising" (29 Sept).

26 Sept days: World Contraception Day (20th, "No Barriers, Just Choices"); UN Int'l Day for Total Elimination of Nuclear Weapons; World Environmental Health Day (15th, "Environmental Health: Standing with Science…").

Asian Games overnight: tally 53 = 6G/21S/26B, 10th; javelin — Yashvir Singh silver (85.72 PB), Rohit Yadav bronze (84.35), Pathirage (Sri Lanka) gold 88.55; Gulveer Singh — first Indian man with 3 individual medals at one Games (5000m bronze 13:32.75); women's 4×400m relay gold 3:29.69; Day 12 — archery compound women's semifinal vs Korea, hockey semifinal vs Korea, Lovlina in boxing.
